import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["ledger"].copy()

    # Sort per legacy cursor ORDER BY
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "entry_date", "row_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to preserve tie order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # amount coalesced to 0 for accumulation purposes
    amt = df["amount"].fillna(0.0)

    # cycle number: starts at 1 per account, increments by 1 on each STMT row
    # (including the STMT row itself, since reset+increment happens before add)
    is_stmt = (df["entry_type"] == "STMT").astype(int)
    cyc = 1 + is_stmt.groupby(df["account_id"]).cumsum()

    df["cycle_no"] = cyc

    # cycle_balance: cumulative sum of amount within (account_id, cycle_no) group,
    # since reset-before-add means bal restarts exactly at each new cycle group
    df["cycle_balance"] = amt.groupby([df["account_id"], df["cycle_no"]]).cumsum()

    result = df[
        ["account_id", "row_seq", "entry_date", "entry_type", "amount",
         "cycle_no", "cycle_balance"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"cycle_balances": result}
